actionContentRequired: Fill in the link address or the JavaScript code
linkAddressTip: Any link works: http(s), siyuan://blocks/<block ID>, assets/<asset path>, mailto: and other protocols registered on the system.
scriptCodeTip: Runs when the button is clicked. Use return for a result, await is supported, and console output shows up in the dialog.
scriptFileTip: A local file lives under assets/ in the workspace and is read again on every click; an http(s) address is downloaded again on every click, so the script changes whenever that file does.
scriptFileCreateTitle: Create a JavaScript file under assets/
scriptFileInvalidName: Invalid file name: it cannot contain ~ [ ] ( ) ! ` & { } = # % $ ; ' / \ : * ? " < > |, or exceed 180 bytes
scriptFileExists: A file with that name already exists under assets/
scriptFileNeeded: Pick a .js file under assets/ first
scriptFileFailed: The file operation failed; see the console for details
cloudWarningTitle: Loading JavaScript from the web may be unsafe
cloudWarningTip: This code comes from the web and can be changed by anyone without you noticing, while a click on the button may read and write your notes. You can give up, or download it into assets/ first and use that copy — once downloaded, the button has nothing to do with the web file any more.
cloudDownloadFailed: The download failed; check that the address is reachable
scriptDocsFailed: The documentation cannot be opened right now
settingsOutputModeTip: When the result dialog opens after a script runs. "With output" is the behaviour the plugin always had: it opens when there is console output, a return value or an error.
settingsAgentSkill: Provide the button block skill to the agent
settingsAgentSkillTip: Writes a skill explaining how button blocks work (payload format, icon list, script APIs) into the workspace skill directory for SiYuan's agent; switching it off deletes that skill
settingsSaveFailed: The settings could not be saved, please retry
blockNotEditable: The button block cannot be edited right now
discardChangesTip: Closing now leaves the button block as it is; this edit is lost.
